annotations.title: List the public contracts a company won

description: Public contracts each company won: US federal (USAspending), every EU/EEA country (TED award notices) and the UK (Contracts Finder). First a summary per company (awards, total value per currency, top buyers, first and last award, legal names the portals used), then every award with buyer, value, date, codes and link. For competitor tracking, sales prospecting and supplier due diligence. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/tenders-radar on your Apify account (about $0.004 per award (summaries free); spend per call is capped at $0.5).

awarded_within_days.description: Awards from the last N days.

countries.description: Limit to "US", "GB", "EU" or EU/EEA ISO codes (default: all three portals).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

name: get_supplier_contracts

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
